prompt: Seamless tileable square albedo texture, photorealistic, for a high-definition remaster of a medieval fantasy game: dry packed dirt ground with loose stone chips. Look like a professional photoscanned texture (Quixel Megascans style): real material, crisp fine detail, natural variation. The reference image is a deliberately blurred layout guide from the old game texture: use it ONLY for scale (how many stone chips fit across the image) and roughly where the darker and lighter areas are. Invent all the actual surface detail fresh and realistic; do not reproduce the blur or any shapes from the guide. Neutral, desaturated, mostly grey tones (the game tints it with colour), even overall brightness. Top-down orthographic, flat diffuse lighting, no cast shadows, no specular highlights, no lighting gradient, no vignette, no text, no border; the left and right edges and the top and bottom edges must continue seamlessly when tiled.
